name: Morán Morán
about_text: Morán Morán is a contemporary art gallery founded in Los Angeles in 2008. Since its early years the gallery has built a program centered on representing emerging and mid-career artists while also presenting historical material, often inviting curators and artists to organize exhibitions, performances, and happenings that push beyond the conventional gallery format. This freeform, experimental approach has become part of the gallery's identity, alongside a stated commitment to inclusivity and diversity in its programming. The gallery represents a roster whose members have received major fellowships and awards and whose works are held in numerous international museum collections. In addition to its Los Angeles space, the gallery maintains a project space in Paris and regularly participates in international art fairs.

triage.site_notes: The site organizes content by /artists/{slug} for individual artist pages (no single roster index page was found in the inventory, though the nav clearly has an 'Artists' link), /exhibitions/{year} archive pages going back to 2008 (and likely earlier), and a large flat collection of press/news article slugs at the domain root; contact info lives under /information and fairs under /fairs. This slice of the inventory consists almost entirely of individual press/news articles about represented artists (Brian Belott, Chelsea Culprit, Keltie Ferris, Eve Fowler, Luis Gispert, George Herms, Becky Kolsrud, Robert Mapplethorpe, RJ Messineo, etc.), functioning as the gallery's press archive; core structural pages like roster index, about, exhibitions current/archive, and contact are not present in this batch and likely exist elsewhere in the site. This slice of the inventory consists almost entirely of press/news articles about gallery artists (Kenny Rivero, Anders Ruhwald, Jacolby Satterwhite, etc.); no roster, about, exhibitions, or contact pages appear in this batch, suggesting those are organized elsewhere on the site.
